answer: Identity is bound to a physical plot. The coast is cut into meadow plots of 2 hectares, each issuing at most 6 identities, every one tied to a plot by a signed low-tide survey photo with a visible horizon. Tide times are public, so quotas refill on a known schedule, and a farm in one warehouse can claim one plot only; renting 167 plots for 1000 aliases costs more than a year of emission. A falcon sweep re-shoots 4% of plots each epoch and compares horizon lines byte for byte; a spoofed site burns the plot's 60 POA bond.
